candidates.claim: Test a minimal port of DeepGEMM #452’s contiguous SM90 FP8 MQA epilogue into the pinned H200 build, conditional on proving active header use and a safe numerical domain. The supplied installed excerpt retains fmaxf and unhalved KV scales, establishing a source-level delta but no execution or bottleneck evidence. The PR author reports H200 microbenchmark gains from substituting full-rate FADD with an absolute-value operand and compensating both output scales. Our transfer hypothesis is lower exposed prefill time and TTFT where uncached requests invoke this kernel; warm-prefix and paged-only traffic should benefit little directly. Compare against the equally compiled, warmed stock epilogue at unchanged launch settings. Reject unconditional bit-exactness: overflow, underflow, exceptional values and downstream top-k stability must be resolved before serving tests. Serving value remains unmeasured.
